mechanism: Fluticasone (corticosteroid) increases risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw and impairs bone metabolism, which is already compromised by zoledronic acid (bisphosphonate); both drugs affect bone turnover and healing.
action: Monitor for signs of osteonecrosis of the jaw, maintain adequate dental hygiene, consider dental evaluation before bisphosphonate therapy, and use lowest effective corticosteroid dose.
